top_signals.title: Aon Nears Deal to Buy Insurance Brokerage From KKR, WSJ Reports
top_signals.summary: Aon is nearing an agreement to buy insurance brokerage USI Insurance from private equity firm KKR & Co. for around $17 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter.
